blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Former PBA star Roger Yap is relishing his experience as head coach of the University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJ-R) Jaguars, who are making noise in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament. Yap and the Jaguars made a surprising run toward the end of the first round, winning four straight games to secure fourth place in the standings. Considered an inexperienced, rookie-laden squad before the season started, the Jaguars have defied expectations under Yap, who is also coaching a collegiate and school-based team for the first time.
